name: duration-picker
title: Duration Picker
description: Hours, minutes and seconds as separate segments you type into, step with the keyboard or scrub by dragging, with rolling digits.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value in seconds when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value in seconds on every change.

props.name: units
props.description: Which segments to show, most significant first.

props.name: step
props.description: Amount added per arrow key press, in the focused unit.

props.name: scrub
props.description: Drag a segment sideways to change its value.
